welcome.title: GharKhoji
welcome.tagline: Find a real room that is actually available today.
welcome.verifiedText: Every owner verifies their phone. Agents are clearly marked with their commission — no surprises.
welcome.availableText: Owners confirm every 2–3 days. If they don't, the room disappears from search. No more calling for rooms already rented.
welcome.transparentText: Rent, water, waste, internet, parking and deposit — all shown upfront before you call anyone.

onboarding.title: Create your account
onboarding.name: Your name
onboarding.tenantDesc: Looking for a room or flat
onboarding.ownerDesc: I own a property to rent out
onboarding.agentDesc: I help owners find tenants (commission shown publicly)
onboarding.roleNote: You can't switch between owner and agent later without verification.
onboarding.subtitle: Owners and tenants see your name, so they know who they're talking to.

profile.title: Profile
profile.guestText: You don't need an account to search. Log in to post a room or contact owners.
profile.safetyText:
• Never pay a deposit before visiting the room.
• Visit with a friend in daylight.
• Check that the owner's name matches their documents.
• Report any listing that asks for money in advance.
profile.howText: Owners confirm their room is still available every 2–3 days. If they don't, it's hidden automatically. Every listing shows the full monthly cost, and agents must show their commission.

mine.loginTitle: Log in to post and manage your rooms
mine.emptyHint: Tap “+ Post” to list your room for free.
mine.rentedText: It will be hidden from search. You can publish it again later.

post.chargesHint: Monthly extra charges — leave empty if included in rent. Tenants see the full total.
post.pinHint: Tap the map or drag the pin to the exact house.

post.outsideValley: Your location is outside Kathmandu Valley. Place the pin by hand.
post.errRent: Enter the monthly rent (Rs 1,000 or more)
post.errPin: Place the pin on the map
post.errCommission: Agents must state their commission (0 if none)

photos.tip: Real, recent photos build trust: bathroom, kitchen, windows, the view. Tap ★ to set the cover photo.

chat.title: Chats
chat.subtitle: Talk to owners and tenants — your number stays private
chat.loginText: Log in to message owners and agents about rooms. Your phone number is never shared.
chat.emptyTenantText: Find a room you like and tap “Chat with owner” to ask anything.
chat.emptyOwnerText: When tenants ask about your rooms, their messages appear here.
chat.safety: Stay safe: never pay a deposit or “advance” before you visit the room in person. Keep your chats inside GharKhoji.
chat.paymentWarning: This message mentions paying money. Never pay before you've seen the room and met the owner.
chat.blockText: Neither of you will be able to send messages in this chat. You can unblock any time.
chat.blockedByOther: You can't reply to this conversation.
chat.reportedText: Our team will review this chat. We've blocked this person for you.
chat.startHint: Ask about availability, a visit time, or anything in the listing. They'll get a notification.
